Overview

A true island escape. Stay in a beach villa and then an overwater villa at a resort in North Malé Atoll, with all meals and drinks included. Your days are for snorkelling the house reef, sunset cruises, spa time and simply doing nothing.

Tour highlights

  • Overwater villa with direct lagoon access
  • All-inclusive meals and soft drinks
  • Speedboat transfers from Malé airport
  • Snorkelling trip with gear
  • Sunset dolphin cruise
  • Romantic dinner on the beach

Frequently asked questions

Do Indians need a visa for the Maldives?

No advance visa is needed. Indian passport holders get a free 30-day tourist visa on arrival with a confirmed resort booking and return ticket.

Is the price per couple?

Yes, ₹1,45,000 is per couple. The final price depends on the resort and travel dates; we will share 2–3 resort options.
